subject: Delta Clinic: temporary log custody request & SIG/CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@deltaclinic.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@deltaclinic.com, andrew.cole@lawfirm-harbor.com
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary custody of session logs + SOC2/SIG artifacts

Hi Diego,

We need Redwood's help to preserve a subset of tenant/session logs for an internal investigation. Our legal team placed a notice this morning requesting a 90-day hold for sessions tied to tenant ID DC-7719 (incident window: 2028-08-20 to 2028-08-27).

Key asks:
- Can you confirm whether you can put a temporary custody/hold on the relevant session logs (beyond your standard 30-day TTL)?
- We need copies of SOC 2 attestation (most recent), SIG/CAIQ mapping that documents where logs are stored, encryption controls, and an outline of the deletion workflow so our auditors can see the end-to-end.
- Sample export: a redacted CSV of 100 session rows (timestamps, tenant_id, routing_id) to validate chain-of-custody.

Attachments: Delta-Investigation-Notice.pdf, RequestMatrix.xlsx (matrix of exact fields we need).

Can you confirm next steps and timelines? Our counsel (Andrew) is cc'd.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior Compliance Manager
Delta Clinic
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@deltaclinic.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary custody of session logs + SOC2/SIG artifacts

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and the notice. I can outline how we handle this and what we need from delta to make it official.

Summary / quick answers:
- Redwood standard session TTL: 30 days. We can implement a tenant-scoped temporary hold for up to 180 days; default process is to mark the tenant's log bucket with a legal_hold flag and prevent automated deletion.
- We will provide: SOC2 attestation, CAIQ mapping (log ownership, KMS key IDs, regions), and a short write-up of the deletion workflow. We can also produce a 100-row redacted CSV export for chain-of-custody.

What we need from Delta to proceed:
1) Formal request signed by legal (PO or MOU) referencing tenant DC-7719 and the requested hold window (start/end). We can accept DocuSign.
2) Legal hold identifier (e.g., your case ID) and scope — confirm whether you want full session payloads or only metadata fields (your RequestMatrix lists the latter).
3) Desired storage region (we default to us-west-2 unless you specify) and KMS expectations (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed).

Estimated timeline once we receive signed MOU + hold ID:
- Hold activation: 4 business hours (tag + block deletion).
- CAIQ/SOC2 artifacts delivered: within 24 hours (we will provide link to secure drive).
- Redacted 100-row export: 48 hours (security review + export).

Attachments I will share: Redwood-MOU-template.docx, SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2028.pdf, CAIQ-Mapping-Redwood-2028.csv (we'll upload final versions to a secure share once the MOU is signed).

Cost note: there is a standard temporary retention handling fee (operational uplift) and an hourly export/forensics fee. I'll detail pricing after you confirm scope — nominal for most customers but we list it up front so procurement can approve.

Next step suggested: sign the attached MOU template and return via DocuSign link we will provide. Naomi (security) and Priyom (CS) are cc'd to assist with the technical handoff and export.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@deltaclinic.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: andrew.cole@lawfirm-harbor.com, compliance@deltaclinic.com
Date: Mon, 03 Sep 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary custody of session logs + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Diego — thanks, that process sounds workable. A few clarifications from our side before we sign:
- Can you confirm whether the retained logs will remain in us-west-2 and be encrypted with our CMK? If CMK can't be supported for this flow, we need confirmation of Redwood-managed KMS and whether key access logs are captured.
- Please provide the SOC2 PDF and the CAIQ mapping link so our auditors can start reviewing while legal finalizes the MOU.
- Also confirm how Redwood will record the chain-of-custody (audit events, timestamps) for the export.

We should be able to sign the MOU by EOD tomorrow once those details are confirmed.

Thanks — Samantha
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@deltaclinic.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, andrew.cole@lawfirm-harbor.com
Date: Tue, 04 Sep 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary custody of session logs + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Samantha — quick answers inline and next steps. Naomi, Priyom — looping you in for technical/ops.

- Region & KMS: We can keep the retained snapshots in us-west-2. Customer-managed CMK is supported for stored exports and longer-term buckets; for short-lived legal holds (<=180 days) we can either use your CMK or Redwood-managed keys. If you require customer-managed CMK, we will request the key ARN and grant a limited-use IAM role for export operations. Key access events will be recorded to our KMS audit logs and included in the CAIQ mapping.

- SOC2 / CAIQ: see secure share (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDeltaSecureShare — we uploaded a redacted SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2028.pdf and CAIQ-Mapping-Redwood-2028.csv.

- Chain-of-custody for export: Exports are performed by Security Ops, each export operation includes: operator ID, timestamp, export manifest (hash of CSV), retention flag set to legal_hold:<your-case-id>, and upload to a customer-specific secure bucket. We'll hand over the manifest and signed operator log with the export.

- Pricing estimate (high level):
  - Hold activation (administrative + tag): $200 one-time
  - Additional storage beyond standard TTL: $0.02/GB/day (estimated; exact depends on exported size)
  - Forensic export & manifest (security ops): $150/hr — typical job 2–4 hours.

Action items for Delta to unblock:
1) Return signed MOU via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/AAABBBCCC-Delta-MOU
2) Confirm key strategy: "customer-CMK" or "redwood-managed" and provide key ARN if CMK.
3) Confirm whether export should include full payloads or metadata-only (RequestMatrix.xlsx indicates metadata-only).

Once we have the above, Security Ops will schedule the export and we will activate the hold (target: within same business day).

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

---
Forwarded attachments (available in secure share): Redwood-MOU-template.docx, SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2028.pdf, CAIQ-Mapping-Redwood-2028.csv
